描述_EN: jingdezhen became an important ceramic producer. some kilns active in the preceding decades ceased production, but the longquan, jun, cizhou and jizhou kilns continued their success. kilns became bigger to take advantage of economy of scale and were managed by competent entrepreneurs. the yuan (1271-1368) is the dynasty when china was ruled by mongol emperors. yuan dynasty ceramics are as popular among collectors as their song dynasty predecessors. this piece is a cizhou ware.
描述_ZN: 景德镇成为一个重要的陶瓷生产地。 年，前几十年活跃的一些窑场停止了生产，但龙泉窑、钧窑、池州窑和吉州窑继续保持了它们的成功。 窑场变得更大，以利用规模经济的优势，并由有能力的企业家管理。 元朝（1271-1368）是中国被蒙古皇帝统治的朝代。 元代的陶瓷和宋代的前辈一样受到收藏家的欢迎。 这件作品是一个贵州器皿。
